facts.business: Optiemus Infracom Limited is engaged in trading and distribution of electronics and manufacturing of electronic products through its subsidiaries, including smartphones, IoT devices, wearables, and tempered glass screen protectors.

capacity_or_capex.item: Tempered glass manufacturing facility in Noida (RhinoTech)
Cover glass manufacturing facility (Bharat Innovative Glass Technologies / BIGTECH)
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Production expected to commence in second half of FY 2026-27

guidance_or_targets.statement: Continue to strengthen core wholesale trading operations, support manufacturing subsidiaries' growth, and pursue opportunities through right products, partnerships and capabilities
guidance_or_targets.value: Build sustainable businesses with financial and operational discipline while creating long-term value

key_risks: Macro-economic headwinds including inflationary pressures and geopolitical uncertainties
Impairment risk on significant investments in subsidiaries and associates (₹46,261.57 Lakhs and ₹8,131.22 Lakhs respectively)
Pending litigations with direct tax, indirect tax and other authorities
Dependence on strategic partnerships with technology brands (Realme, OnePlus, Nothing, Nxtquantum, Ordinary Theory)
facts.related_party_note: Strategic manufacturing partnerships with Realme, OnePlus, Nothing Electronics, Nxtquantum Shift Technologies, and Ordinary Theory LLC; Joint venture with Corning International through Bharat Innovative Glass Technologies (BIGTECH); Subsidiaries include Optiemus Electronics Limited (100%), GDN Enterprises (100%), BIGTECH (70%), Optiemus Unmanned Systems (100%), Troosol (60%), FineMS Electronics (60%), Optiemus Infracom Singapore (100%), Optiemus Display Technology, Optiemus Vision Technology, Optiemus Micro Electronics, XO Ventures, The Factory
